optimization_notes: Baseline includes all six manifest service/environment lines, 10 endpoint-hours lines grouped by prod/dev/shared placement, 60 GB aggregate Private Link processing, five shared private DNS zones and one million shared monthly queries.
Private DNS zone cost assumes the five zones fall in the first 25-zone billing tier as supplied; pre-existing billing-scope zones could change tier allocation.
The Prod P0v3 reservation comparison is savings analysis only and is not deducted from the on-demand baseline. Dev P0v3 remains on-demand and is not planned for a commitment.
savings_reason: Only the Prod Linux P0v3 plan is planned for a commitment. Reused same-day swedencentral 1 Year Reservation evidence reports retailPrice USD 508 as the reservation term total; Microsoft Learn Retail Prices API guidance confirms Reservation retailPrice carries the term total. Monthly equivalent=$508/12=$42.33333333; versus the Prod on-demand $64.97/month, savings=$22.63666667/month and $271.64/year (34.84%). Dev is also P0v3 but is not planned for a commitment and is excluded from reservation savings. DTU-based SQL Database Standard S2 and S0 are not reservation-eligible per the Azure SQL Database reserved-capacity Limitation: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/azure-sql/database/reserved-capacity-overview?view=azuresql .
